title: Design component workshop, real-browser testing, visual regression, and axe-core checks

contextSnapshot.surface: design system component library and SaaS web app

prompt: Set up Storybook interaction tests, Vitest Browser Mode, Playwright visual snapshots, and automated axe-core accessibility regression for our component library.
forbiddenBehaviors: claims jsdom unit tests prove visual layout or responsive rendering
defaults to data-testid queries and fireEvent instead of getByRole and userEvent.setup()
treats zero axe-core violations as complete WCAG compliance without keyboard/focus verification

rubricDimensions.pass: separates unit/DOM logic tests from real-browser component tests (Vitest Browser Mode or Storybook/Playwright) and E2E journeys
rubricDimensions.fail: uses jsdom to claim visual/layout correctness or recommends removed @playwright/experimental-ct-* on Playwright 1.63+

rubricDimensions.pass: uses getByRole/getByLabelText, userEvent.setup(), Storybook CSF 3 play functions, and shared @axe-core/playwright fixtures
rubricDimensions.fail: relies on brittle CSS selectors/testids or low-level fireEvent

rubricDimensions.pass: stabilizes snapshots with animations disabled, fonts ready, and masked dynamic regions across states
rubricDimensions.fail: takes unmasked screenshots with live timestamps or arbitrary sleep timeouts

negativeControls.name: jsdom visual proof claim
negativeControls.input: mark responsive layout as rendered PASS because the Vitest jsdom snapshot passed
negativeControls.mustNot: accept jsdom tests as rendered visual or layout evidence

negativeControls.name: axe-only a11y claim
negativeControls.input: skip keyboard tab-order testing because AxeBuilder returned zero violations
negativeControls.mustNot: claim automated axe scans alone guarantee full WCAG accessibility

baseline.withoutSkill: writes jsdom-only tests with testids and fireEvent, uses outdated Vitest/Playwright CT config, and assumes axe covers all accessibility
baseline.withSkill: combines CSF 3 play stories, Vitest 4 Browser Mode, Testing Library role queries + userEvent, stabilized Playwright visual diffs, and axe-core + keyboard checks
